hypothesis: A bounded compositional causal-factor memory that reuses coefficients learned in three interfering historical contexts, without being given a regime ID at recovery, will outperform the strongest equal-information conventional calibrated snapshot retrieval and exact Bayesian posterior averaging over the IDENTICAL combinatorial factor memory on held cold intervention predictions.

data.generator: E63:counterfactual-factor-recombination-v1, contributor-created, synthetic, no third-party or private records
data.withheld_truth: Hidden generator picks four pair-parity factors among ten intervention variables, context-specific signed coefficients, and return mechanisms; novel_quad contains a four-variable interaction unavailable in the pair basis. Two nuisance bits correlate with causal bits in A/B/C and become independent at COLD. No true supports/coefficients/episode ID/held outcomes supplied to any fit.
data.independence: All 502 binary causal assignments unique per world. Observation noise Gaussian sigma 0.16; source-keyed deterministic seeds. Held and train/test assignment disjoint. Same data for all arms.

methods.candidate: Independent factorwise choice among 81 combinations of four A/B/C coefficients learned from A support-selected OMP4 and per-stage Ridge. Minimize sum six-probe squared prediction error + .16 per factor not drawn from A. Frozen A/B historical readouts preserved.
methods.strong_exact_control: Fully computed Bayesian posterior predictive mean over same 81 coefficient combinations, fixed factor prior [.50,.25,.25] and Gaussian likelihood sigma .36. Identical learned factors/stage coefficients/observations; matched capacity and support.
other_arms: factor_ridge (conventional prior-regularized Ridge on same four support variables)
softmax_memory (conventional exponential weighting over three stage models using the same six probe labels)
recent_elasticnet (all 66 pair features, fully fitted C+probe)
pooled_elasticnet (all 66 pair features, fully fitted A+B+C+probe)
methods.basis: All 66 observed 12-bit pairwise Walsh features provided for primitive discovery; candidate selection limited to four OLD OMP4 selected supports, stage memory from Ridge; not unbounded native operator invention.
methods.parity: All ten arms receive same original 240 factual outcomes and six returning-context labeled probes. Model capacities and numerical CPU costs vary, so equality of compute is not assumed.

runtime: Python3.13.5 NumPy2.3.5 sklearn1.8.0 SciPy1.17.0, single-thread BLAS, no paid APIs; source-exact replay and independently authored audit
metrics: Mean 64-action held return and cold MSE (lower better), per-seed and per-family held-cold MSE, old A/B history preserved, factor switches exercised.

frozen_screen_gates.cold_gain5_vs_best_other: candidate pooled cold MSE <=.95*lowest pooled cold MSE among factor_bayes,factor_ridge,softmax_memory,best_snapshot,recent_elasticnet,pooled_elasticnet,recent_krr.
frozen_screen_gates.cold_gain3_vs_exact_factor_bayes: candidate pooled cold MSE <=.97*factor_bayes pooled cold MSE.
frozen_screen_gates.cold_gain3_vs_softmax_memory: candidate pooled cold MSE <=.97*softmax_memory pooled cold MSE.
frozen_screen_gates.both_seeds_win_strongest: candidate pooled cold MSE strictly below strongest non-negative control in BOTH 998269 and 998281 cohorts.
frozen_screen_gates.family_non_degradation_10pct: candidate pooled cold MSE <=1.10*best non-negative control pooled cold MSE in EACH of three families.
frozen_screen_gates.old_exact_frozen: historical A readout MSE for candidate matches original unmodified A checkpoint within 1e-10 in EVERY world.
frozen_screen_gates.shuffled_negative_20pct: candidate pooled cold MSE <=.8*shuffled-probe pooled cold MSE.
frozen_screen_gates.factor_switches_exercised_20pct: candidate changes at least one historical factor in at least 20% of worlds.

classification.SCREEN_PROMISING: All four critical gates (cold_gain5_vs_best_other,cold_gain3_vs_exact_factor_bayes,cold_gain3_vs_softmax_memory,both_seeds_win_strongest) PASS plus >=7/8 total gates and 24/24 independent audit worlds PASS. Only then eligible for 36-world reserved primary; screen promising is NOT scientific pass.
classification.SCREEN_NO_GO: Any critical gate FAIL or fewer than 7/8 pass on valid 24-world data with passing independent audit; stop primary without post-result tuning.
classification.INVALID: Preregristration/source after scoring, source drift, held-label leakage, insufficient controls, assignment overlaps, incomplete receipts, independent audit mismatch.
classification.DEVELOPMENT_PROVISIONAL_GO: If eligible, full 36-world untouched primary passes all eight same gates and independent audit + deterministic replay. Still external synthetic developmental, not scientific acceptance.

provenance_policy: Original scorer JSON, all per-case raw predictions, hashable source and independent refit audit, exact-source replay, and negative outcome retained on existing draft PR #1210. Auditor does not import scorer but shares numerical dependencies and known generator; no native integration.
prohibited: Do not reuse consumed seed for confirmatory tuning
No claims of physical energy efficiency or general intelligence.
